svg.title: PC-12 FUSELAGE OPENINGS
svg.desc: PC12-L3 rev A, AS SHOWN, A1. RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION.

Windows: Lame curve n 4.2 (detail A), 9 in all. Doors: published clear openings (W x H, projected) inside the drawn panel seams (rows D1s / D2s). Section A-A: hinges and open positions.

= cabin crown - 582; *render: CL below the D1 top seam (perspective not modelled)

panel seams (drawn); clear openings R85 / R55
D1: free edge ~5 cm off the ground (contact ~164, section A-A); D2: render, door open (~120)

D DWG: vs the registered Pilatus NGX drawing (sheet-1 side view; starboard: its plan view; exit WLs: sheet-1 stbd detail). D RENDER: vs the Pilatus tech-data side render after a scale + offset fit of the port pattern. REV A: the model before this refit.
STAGE 3 - WHAT MUST FOLLOW THESE CONSTANTS

Door cut-outs: cut the skin and the door slabs along DOOR_PANELS (seams 640 x 1400 / 1400 x 1469), build the jambs / door frames along the clear openings AIRSTAIR / CARGO (610 x 1350 / 1350 x 1320); openings_field(), build_skin() door_edges, build_door() and build_doors() still use

Door kinematics: build_doors() passes open_angle 128 / 100 literally -- read AIRSTAIR['open_deg'] 160 (free edge ~5 cm off the ground, section A-A) and CARGO['open_deg'] 120, the hinge WLs from hinge_line() (1254 / 2604, on the panel); airstair steps / handrails and the cargo-door struts
move with the doors; the airstair door has NO window.

model/interior.py: FLOOR_Z 1.12 -> the door sills WL 1254 (L1 proposes 1259); carpet 4.46-9.52 and the seats must clear D1 4665-5275 and D2 7565-8915 (D1 moved +255 mm aft, D2 -685 mm fwd); window reveals from window_outline() (Lame n 4.2) at WIN_CZ 2188 (+178 mm).

model/interior.py build_structure(): frames at window +/- 0.40 m -> the Pilatus frames (fuselage.FRAMES FR16-FR33), interrupted at openings_table() (P3 / S3 at 6980 straddle FR25 6971: window-frame forging or local jog); the window-belt stringer gap 1.70 < z < 2.32 -> about 1.95-2.43 (belt

Emergency exit: build_doors() names it 'Type III' -- the drawn plug hatch is 0.482 x 0.641 m projected (0.696 along the skin, FAR 23.807(b) 19 x 26 in); E1 moved from STA 5520 to 6205, over the wing: check the wing-root fairing and flap clearance.

Livery (model/livery.py): the swoosh (WL 1.28-1.52) crosses both door panels -- paint the panel slabs, not the clear openings; the PRO dark cockpit mask's aft edge meets the D1 forward seam (STA 4650).
Wing-root fairing (wing / details): hides the lower D2 seam in side view (drawn low seam WL 1160); the fairing must not cut into the D2 panel aft of STA 7540.
refs/mbp.py '[vs model]' checks hard-code the rev-A stations (5.52 ... 8.72): switch them to fuselage_parts.openings_table() (rows now carry panel and open_deg).
Door frames / jambs (build_doors seams): re-check the jamb loop pick and the D2 slab against the aft fuselage split SPLIT_AFT 9.85 (D2 panel ends at 8940).

Drawn from the opening constants of model/fuselage_parts.py on the Stage-2 OML of model/fuselage.py (sheet L1), never from the mesh. STA = mm aft of the datum (3000 fwd of the firewall); WL above the static ground line.

Positions follow the registered Pilatus NGX drawing (port: side view; starboard: plan view -- the sheet-1 starboard detail repeats the port window stations and is not used). The drawn door outlines are the door-panel seams (the Pilatus tech-data render shows the same 0.64 / 1.40 m seams); the
published door sizes (projected W x H) are the clear openings inside them.
PRO: no window in the airstair door (s/n 3001 photo, door closed; Pilatus render). The cockpit side window is context only (model/cockpit_glazing.py, glazing sheet).
WHAT IT SHOWS FOR THE OPENINGS
orthographic-like CGI side view: D1 / D2 seams + P1-P4 fit OUR stations within 7 mm (rms 3); seams 639 / 1400 wide; window 302 x 381; no D1 window
cargo door raised ~120 deg (free edge ~0.99 m above the hinge); sill at the cabin floor, 3 latches in the lower frame
S1-S5 at STA 5318, 6137, 6884, 7589, 8338 (spinner/cowl registered, 166.7 px/m); pattern fit to ours <= 11 mm; E1 hatch ~0.49-0.50 x 0.62-0.64
D1 open (0.61 = scale bar), P1-P3, D2 open (hinged at top); pattern fit <= 14 mm; D2/D1 width 2.20
airstair door CLOSED: outline visible, NO window; 4 windows aft of it (P1-P3 + P4 in D2)
P1-P3 w/h 0.80, pitch ratio 0.75 (ours 0.76); P3 aft edge to D2 fwd edge 1.41 window widths (ours 1.45)
S1, E1 (outlined, red placard above its window = handle), S3-S5: same row as the NGX, S1-E1 the widest pitch
